description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rate of exchange with effect from 16.04.2018 to 22.04.2018
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued by the Director General of Customs under the authority of the Customs Ordinance. It establishes new official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges, and rescinds a previous notification. This constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement for import/export matters, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5).
